gold.user: A project manager wants to retrieve all property keys associated with a specific project to understand its configuration and custom settings.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of property keys for the specified project, allowing the user to see all custom properties that have been set.

gold.user: A developer needs to check the value of a specific property key in a project to ensure that the project settings align with the development requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should return the value of the specified property key for the project, enabling the developer to verify the configuration.

gold.user: A team lead wants to update a project property to reflect new requirements after a recent project review.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the specified property key with the new value, confirming the change has been made.

gold.user: An administrator decides to remove an outdated property key from a project to clean up the project settings.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully delete the specified property key from the project, indicating that it is no longer available.
